class.name: UZUTouchStick
class.brief_description: A virtual analog stick for touch layouts, drawn from the UZUUI theme's colours.
class.description: [UZUTouchStick] is the touch part of the UZUUI kit (see [method UZUUI.make_touch_stick]): a disc and a knob drawn from the theme colours registered under the [code]UZUTouchStick[/code] type variation ([code]base_color[/code], [code]ring_color[/code], [code]knob_color[/code], [code]knob_ring_color[/code]), so a world theme restyles it like every other part. A finger (or the mouse) drags the knob; the stick reports an analog [member value] with a [member deadzone] applied, through [signal value_changed]. It deliberately does not touch the input map: feeding engine actions from the value is the game's job, so the same part serves any control scheme. The pointer surface is public ([method press_at], [method drag_to], [method release]) as well as wired to GUI input, so an AI player or a test can drive the stick exactly the way a finger does, in local coordinates. [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine.

method.name: drag_to
method.description: Moves the knob to a local position while a press is active (see [method press_at]); does nothing when no press is active.

method.name: get_knob_offset
method.description: Returns where the knob sits, in px from the centre — the drawn state, for tests and AI verification.

method.name: press_at
method.description: Begins a press at a local position and moves the knob there, the way a touch or mouse press inside the stick does.

method.name: release
method.description: Ends any active press: the value and the knob return to the centre and [signal released] is emitted.

signal.name: released
signal.description: Emitted when a press ends and the stick returns to the centre.

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the stick's analog value changes (drags and releases).

members.member: The fraction of the knob's travel that reports a zero value, rescaled so the rest of the travel still reaches 1.0.
The analog value: a vector of length at most 1. Setting it moves the knob to match; drags update it with the [member deadzone] applied.
